entities.summary: Rufino "Chico" Bernedo Zorzano was a Chilean basketball player. At a height of 1.72 m tall, he played at the small forward position. He is considered to be among the best Chilean basketball players ever. In November 2013, Sebastián Piñera, the President of Chile, inaugurated a sports center bearing his name, in his honor, in the city of Temuco.
